authoritative_identity.rule: Website, game and admin player views resolve the same oldko.accounts/oldko.characters rows; no admin copy player database is created.
authoritative_identity.admin_principal_rule: Privileged admin identities are separate oldko.admin_actors principals and are never inferred from display labels such as ROOT OWNER.

adapter_contract.transaction_rule: WS08 mutation + appendAudit can run in one SERIALIZABLE PgWs08AdminRepository transaction; sanction enforcement outbox inserts can participate in the same transaction.
adapter_contract.online_rule: No stale player online boolean is persisted. Active WS45 character leases are the default DB runtime signal, and an injected runtimeAuthority.isCharacterOnline resolver is supported.
adapter_contract.online_mutation_rule: Direct character/stat/skill/zone persistence rejects active characters. Online mutations must be routed through game authority/outbox; outbox rows capture expected world/progression/item versions for downstream CAS checks.
adapter_contract.inn_compatibility_rule: Authoritative WS17 storage remains 196 slots. WS08 current HTTP shape exposes 192 slots without deleting, renumbering or overwriting the remaining persisted slots.

order.ledger: WS13 service-owned migration; do not insert it into the WS07 numbered migration ledger

changed_shared_export.reason: Adds PgWs08AdminRepository/WS08_REQUIRED_METHODS exports while preserving existing WS03/WS13 and other adapter exports.

compatibility_receipt.consumer_pin_action: Consumers with exact WS07 commit/blob guards may update their WS07 pin to source_commit after validating this receipt. WS03 and WS13 direct adapter blobs are unchanged; the shared adapters/index.js blob changed only to expose WS08.

source_ci.note: Same production adapter/migration code; source_commit adds checksum observability only.

evidence: Exact WS08 REQUIRED_METHODS contract is implemented against real PostgreSQL.
Shared oldko.accounts/oldko.characters rows are used by admin reads and mutations.
Offline character/stat/skill state remains visible after repository recreation.
Injected transaction failure rolls both state mutation and audit entry back.
Audit log and item serial event history reject update/delete and remain append-only.
Active WS45 character lease blocks direct persistent character mutation.
Durable idempotency replay returns the stored response; same key with different request conflicts.
Outbox trace replay is idempotent and concurrent workers claim distinct commands using row locking/SKIP LOCKED.
Admin actor/session persistence survives repository recreation and session revocation is durable.
Fresh migration applies 0001-0004 once and a second migration pass is a no-op/checksum verification.
Upgrade test applies 0001 alone, then upgrades through 0004, reruns migrations, and verifies the final schema.
Existing WS03 async auth/session persistence integration remains green.
Existing WS17, WS14, WS27, WS22, WS45, WS46 persistence/concurrency tests remain green.
Connection interruption test confirms interrupted work fails and the PostgreSQL pool recovers.

backup_recovery.rule: WS30 full logical database backups include additive WS07 0004 tables; restoration must preserve and verify public._oldko_migrations before service validation.

blockers.detail: WS08 currently intentionally fails closed for ADMIN_REPOSITORY=ws07. Instantiate PgWs08AdminRepository with the production PostgreSQL pool and keep WS08's REQUIRED_METHODS verifier. WS07 does not edit WS08 server/business-rule files.
WS08's current Idempotency-Key Map is process-local. Replace/wrap it with reserveAdminOperation/completeAdminOperation so request key/hash and response survive process restart.

If domain-live requires admin login/session survival across restart, wire oldko.admin_actors/admin_sessions through the provided facade. Browser display labels, ROOT OWNER text and frontend authority fields are never identity proof.

Game-affecting online commands must be consumed by game/runtime authority and compare captured expected world/progression/item versions before application. Direct online SQL writes are intentionally rejected.
Apply the exact migration_plan order to the production PostgreSQL database. WS07 only delivers tested code/plan and does not perform the production cutover.
